stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data, via College Navigator (fall 2024): 21,765 applicants, 60% admitted, 10% of admits enrolled; admit and enrollee counts are not printed there. No readable Common Data Set was found (the Institutional Research site is behind a campus login), so GPA, residency and international splits are not available. 338 enrolled first-years (26%) submitted SAT; SAT section percentiles are those of submitters and only SAT is reported (no ACT percentiles; no SAT composite percentile is published). Undergraduate enrollment 4,903 is fall 2024. The applicant, admit and enrolled counts are the exact IPEDS figures for fall 2023, because the newer source gives only a rounded admit rate.

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25 for full-time beginning undergraduates living on campus; tuition includes required fees. Current 2026-27 figures are in the cycle file
